attempt: Reload an overwritten foliage PNG at the same path through Texture.fromPath and immediately export the project.
reason_failed: Blockbench displayed the prior procedural foliage while the file on disk contained the new generated bough; the editor preview could misrepresent the active texture and an early source export could embed stale pixels.
error_signature: Disk PNG and editor texture disagree after replacing same-path atlas
workaround: Read updated PNG bytes, load via fromDataURL, await image load, update material, then export. Verify embedded source-image SHA256 against the runtime PNG.

source_refs.description: All six final source embeddings match the atlas bytes
